capabilities: Suggest words from the current note and a vault-wide word index
Load custom dictionaries and optional CC-CEDICT word lists
Pause suggestions during Chinese IME composition
Store completion history and settings in the vault
extras: Settings and commands are in Chinese by default; only one autocomplete plugin should be enabled at a time; a full Android/iOS device and IME test matrix has not been completed; a remote dictionary is downloaded only when the user configures and enables its URL.
intentEvidence: This is an independently maintained derivative of Various Complements 11.4.2 by tadashi-aikawa.
motivation: To provide a Chinese-first version of Various Complements, with a Chinese settings interface, whole-phrase commit handling and pausable indexing.
problem: Typing in Obsidian offers no word-level completion, and Chinese input needs phrase suggestions that wait for IME composition to finish.

relations.evidence: This is an independently maintained derivative of Various Complements 11.4.2 by tadashi-aikawa.

summary: Chinese-first offline autocomplete suggesting words from the current note, a vault-wide index, note links, properties, custom dictionaries and history.
